title: GH Hino 2018 Non FUPS Polished Alloy Bullbar #2
description: Hino GH Non FUPS Polished Alloy Bullbar. Features one piece 76mm heavy wall high tensile aluminium pipe which passes through the drilled centre box uprights and is recessed into the external uprights. Custom made removable grills protect the headlights which are still attached to the chassis. The heavy duty high tensile aluminium main channel is kept straight for maximum strength. Heavy duty 38mm tow pin is fitted through the high tensile aluminium backing plate. Driving light or light bar mounts can be fitted to suit customer requirements.
